purpose: Treat essential executable runtime, codecs and dependency lock closure as independent preservable assets without treating a GitHub repo as a reproducible binary environment.
policy: Do not fetch/install/run software; planning only. Commit SHAs, lockfiles and artifact SHA must be determined before authorization.
Pinned repo source is not equivalent to an offline executable Python/CUDA environment: include matching wheel/driver OS image and ABI.
Respect software and pretrained model weights separate license terms.
If legacy unsafe pickle loading is needed, keep offline sandbox and require separate execution authorization.
Only qualified model-to-runtime edge is recorded. An entry does not prove all advertised model families can run on that backend.

knowledge_assets_to_plan.description: Exactly versioned LICENSE / gate text and observed revision+date; log withdrawal/termination obligations without private acceptance credentials.
Source model card, chosen path, upstream SHA256 where supplied, local SHA256 after authorized transfer and original size; never equate Git SHA1 or Xet object ID with file SHA256.
Versioned lock/requirements, OS/architecture, Python ABI, compiler/CUDA/ROCm version, Docker/OCI digest and golden input-output tests.
Paper DOI/arXiv, official benchmarks and input licensing, model architecture and training/post-training provenance. Never mark vendor result as independent benchmark.
